logline: Man United are 19th in both the Premier League and the Champions League, so Pochettino flips the table upside down: 2nd! But the 36-team table only gives 18th, VAR flips it back, and his new banner reads TOP 2, counting from the bottom.

beats.idea: close on Bruno, sad, standing on row 19 of a giant Premier League table tower; pull out
Pochettino walks in, pulls a FLIP lever; the tower spins 180°; Bruno hangs upside down at 2nd
upside-down champagne: Pochettino cheers SO PROUD, the cork shoots down and BONKs him, foam pours on him
Champions League tower, 36 rows; 19th is the middle; flip → 18th
Pochettino pumps the lever: the tower spins three times; Bruno dizzy; still 18th
VAR monitor rolls in: TABLE UPSIDE DOWN ❌ → flipped back, CLUNK, Bruno back to 19th
a banner unrolls: TOP 2 🏆 — zoom to the asterisk: *counting from the bottom; Bruno deadpan to camera
Pochettino leans proudly on the lever: the tower flips again, Bruno upside down in front of TOP 2; ticker 19th · 19th; question + CTA

twist: the flip only works in a 20-team table; in a 36-team table 19th is the middle, so nothing changes
callback: the FLIP lever from the start is triggered again by accident at the end
hidden_details: the PREMIER LEAGUE header ends up upside down on the grass
the ticker lists the next three opponents
meme_frame: Bruno hanging upside down in front of the TOP 2* banner
hook_frame0: cover: 19th = TOP 2?! 🙃 — Bruno upside down on the table
